Explore Salary Structures and Salary Rules

User manual · English · 8 steps
Learn how payroll is organised: how a salary structure groups the rules that compute each payslip, and how to read the rules a structure contains.

1. Open Payroll

Open the Payroll app.

2. Configuration menu

Open the Configuration menu.

3. Structures

Click Structures.

4. Open a group

Click a group name to show its structures.

5. Open a structure

Click a structure to open it.

6. Salary Rules tab

Click the Salary Rules tab.

7. Read the rules

Look at the Category column, then click it to continue.

8. Finish

Click the structure name in the breadcrumb to finish.
